_about: Editorial overrides applied by scripts/normalize-raw.mjs. `audience` marks routes only open to a specific group. The app never asks about these characteristics, so such routes are labelled on cards and only reach the shortlist if the person likes or saves them.

audience: People who use assistive technology (lived disability experience)
Ontario residents with a disability or long-term health condition
People fluent in English and an Indigenous language such as Cree or Inuktitut
People in Ontario who were laid off or have been unemployed for a long stretch
People who can get to a University of Toronto campus
